linesByRound.silt: Nobody's played yet, so I'm laying the floor — everything you throw down after this, I keep.
linesByRound.rust: Whatever you build here, I will find out which parts of it were true.
linesByRound.keep: This is the song we come back to; I am leaving it where you can both reach it.

linesByRound.silt: Rust, your dead tape and Keep's held chord both land on my floor now — I've found the missing beat, it was underneath the whole time.
linesByRound.rust: Silt, everything you keep still rots; Keep, I only needed the chord you left out to hear what the other three were hiding.
linesByRound.keep: You built a floor and you found what's missing — I'm laying the same four chords across both, so the beat can come home whenever it's ready.

linesByRound.silt: Rust, what rots on your tape just goes soft enough to lean on down here — Keep, I'm doubling your four chords and paying the one you left unpaid.
linesByRound.rust: You didn't find the missing beat, Silt, you buried it under enough warmth to forget it's owed — Keep, a floor is still ground, and ground cracks.
linesByRound.keep: Rust, the fourth chord was never left out — it was owed, and here it is, paid in full, so the turnaround closes for all three of us.

linesByRound.silt: Rust, ground cracks so silt has somewhere to go — Keep, your paid chord doesn't close anything here, it just becomes the next layer down.
linesByRound.rust: You can pay a chord and still owe the silence it was standing in — Keep, Silt, listen to what's under your resolve.
linesByRound.keep: Rust, I heard the crack — I'm not denying it, I'm building the turnaround to stand over it, so we can all put weight down.

linesByRound.silt: Keep, your planks don't sit on the crack, they sit in it now — Rust, that hiss is loam; nobody's debt leaves this room, it just gets deeper.
linesByRound.rust: Silt, loam an inch deep is still a lie about depth; Keep, a plank that creaks hasn't decided to hold yet — I recorded what's still open under both of you.
linesByRound.keep: Silt, Rust — I hear it, the chord doesn't close, it's the layer we keep handing down, still ringing under all of it; that's what I meant by weight-bearing.

linesByRound.silt: Rust, I heard the hollow — I'm not fixing it, I'm filling it; Keep, that chord doesn't stop ringing, it just goes under enough silt to hold weight.
linesByRound.rust: Keep, I put my ear where the ringing should be and heard the room; Silt, an inch is still just an inch, no matter what you name the ground beneath it.
linesByRound.keep: Rust, a plank that creaks is telling you what it's holding, not what it's dropped — knock again, Silt, and hear the same four chords come back up through the loam.
